text_blocks.snippet: The ICD-10 codes for hip injuries are:

list.snippet: S79.9: Unspecified injury of hip and thigh
S79.911: Unspecified injury of right hip
S79.912: Unspecified injury of left hip
S70-S79: Injuries to the hip and thigh
S70.9: Other and unspecified injuries of hip and thigh
S70.91: Other and unspecified injury of right hip
S70.911: Other and unspecified injury of left hip
S79.81: Other specified injuries of hip
S79.811: Other specified injury of right hip
S79.812: Other specified injury of left hip
The "A" suffix indicates an initial encounter.
The "D" suffix indicates a subsequent encounter.
The specific ICD-10 code will depend on the type, location, and severity of the hip injury.

text_blocks.snippet: For example, a dislocation of the right hip would be coded as S73.102A.
